summary_en: This phase 1 trial tests miRisten, a miR-126 inhibitor, in adults with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML). miRisten is given through a vein (IV) over 30 minutes, twice a day, on days 1-5, 8-12 and 15-19, as long as the disease does not progress and side effects are not unacceptable. The study measures safety, side effects and the best dose of miRisten.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 1 evalúa miRisten, un inhibidor de miR-126, en adultos con leucemia mieloide aguda (LMA) recidivante o refractaria. Se administra por vía intravenosa durante 30 minutos, dos veces al día, en los días 1 a 5, 8 a 12 y 15 a 19, siempre que la enfermedad no progrese y los efectos secundarios no sean inaceptables. El estudio mide la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la mejor dosis de miRisten.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with relapsed or refractory AML
ECOG performance status of 2 or lower
Has failed treatment with, or cannot receive, available AML therapies
Recovered to grade 1 or lower from side effects of prior cancer treatment (except hair loss)
Life expectancy of at least 3 months
not_for: Allogeneic stem cell transplant within 3 months before starting treatment
Chemotherapy, radiation or immunotherapy within 14 days (hydroxyurea allowed)
Unstable heart disease, or acute coronary syndrome or revascularization within 6 months
Other active cancer, or pregnant or breastfeeding
